meta.title: 提拔管理者：三个原因与选人标准
meta.title_en: Promoting a Manager: Three Reasons and the Selection Criteria

scenes.title_en: Three reasons: bandwidth, backup, and capability
scenes.context: 讲者开场说「他那个气场就是当老板的」，然后拆解提拔管理层的三个原因：管理时间和精力不够、团队超十人需第二级管理者、为自己做 backup 准备。
sentences: 他那个气场就是当老板的，所以我肯定要提拔他。
He just has the aura of a boss, so I'm definitely promoting him.
气场：aura
管理团队的时间和精力不够了，团队超过十人一定要有第二级管理者。
Managing the team has run out of time and energy; past ten people you need a second-tier manager.
第二级管理者：second-tier manager
万一有一天我生病、升职或转岗了，我的团队谁来管？
What if one day I get sick, promoted, or transferred — who runs my team?
转岗：get transferred
paraphrase: 气场判断 → 直觉开场
Reading a person's aura kicks off the decision.
团队超十人 → 需要第二级
A team over ten calls for another layer of management.
scenes.speak: He just has the aura of a boss, so I'm definitely promoting him. Managing the team has run out of time and energy; past ten people you need a second-tier manager. What if one day I get sick, promoted, or transferred — who runs my team?

scenes.title_en: How to choose: read his awareness level
scenes.context: 讲者指出选人要看对方能否站在自己角度 hold 住部门，看团队利益是否第一、对同事是否有支撑、大家是否服气不抵触。
sentences: 他能不能站在我的角度 hold 住这个部门？
Can he hold the department from my perspective?
站在我的角度：from my perspective
他是否把团队利益放在第一位，而不是个人利益？
Does he put the team's interests first instead of his own?
把团队利益放第一位：put the team first
我一旦提拔一个人，下面全部反水了，我怎么搞啊？
If everyone mutinies after one promotion, what am I supposed to do?
反水：mutiny / turn against me
paraphrase: 意识水平 → hold 住部门
Awareness is the ability to hold the department.
团队利益 → 服众标准
Team-first thinking is the test of trust.
scenes.speak: Can he hold the department from my perspective? Does he put the team's interests first instead of his own? If everyone mutinies after one promotion, what am I supposed to do?

scenes.title_cn: 过去的领导力与意见领袖
scenes.title_en: Proven leadership and being an opinion leader
scenes.context: 讲者强调要选在过去没被任命时就展现领导力的人：主动、帮助大家、主动补位，而且是敢在周会上发言的意见领袖。
sentences: 这个人应该是在过去没有被任命时，就已经 leadership 很强。
This person should already show strong leadership before being appointed.
还没被任命：before being appointed
leadership 就是主动性、帮助大家、主动补位。
Leadership means initiative, helping others, and stepping in proactively.
主动补位：step in proactively
在周会上别人不敢说话时，他会自然地说：我有点想法。
When others stay silent at the weekly meeting, he naturally says: I have some thoughts.
意见领袖：opinion leader
paraphrase: 未任命先表现 → 真领导力
Real leadership shows before the title.
周会敢发言 → 意见领袖
Speaking up at meetings marks an opinion leader.
scenes.speak: This person should already show strong leadership before being appointed. Leadership means initiative, helping others, and stepping in proactively. When others stay silent at the weekly meeting, he naturally says: I have some thoughts.

practice: I'm definitely promoting him for that role.
A team over ten needs a second-tier manager.
He puts the team's interests first.
He shows strong leadership before the title.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：His air is to be a boss.
✓ 地道说法：He has the aura of a boss.
aura 比 air 更能表达「气场」。
✕ 直译腔：When the team over ten people.
✓ 地道说法：When the team passes ten people.
✓ 地道说法：Everyone mutinies / turns against me.
反水要意译为 mutiny 或 turn against。
✕ 直译腔：He is an opinion person.
✓ 地道说法：He's an opinion leader.
shifts: 把提拔当解决管理带宽与 backup 问题
看团队利益、服众与补位意识
没被任命时已展现领导力才值得提拔
